_help: Log section of the page: at most 10 rows, shown in date order (UTC). Each row: date (YYYY-MM-DD), text, links. A link is {"label", "commit": <subject prefix>} (resolved with git log, so it survives a history rewrite), {"label", "event": <id in events.json>} (date and URL from the server), or {"label", "path": <repo file>}. A row with "user" instead of "text" is a placeholder the author fills in; the build marks it and --strict fails on it.

rows.text: First commit: design specification and project skeleton.
PREVENT base equations, cross-checked against two published implementations (Python and R).
Answer key: the guideline's decision table in code, every row with its quoted sentence.
Answer key reviewed against the guideline text by a separate model; three rules changed (row 5, rows 11a and 11b, row-7 sampling).
Record-edit engine, agent tools and a code verifier; first runs of a local open-weights model on development records.
Upstream pull request to Synthea: the wellness eGFR check skipped patients with hypertension.
Comment on Synthea issue #1793: two code-level findings on the generated eGFR values.
Generator defect: 826 of 9,883 adults have a diabetic kidney code or a glucose-lowering drug but no diabetes diagnosis. Excluded from sampling; answer key unchanged.
